<thought>We need a template that performs the substitution of an aliphatic hydroxyl group with a halogen (C–O bond broken, C–X bond formed). The functional groups involved are “aliphatic hydroxyls” (broken) and “alkyl halide” (formed). To find a suitable template, we can search the template catalog using these criteria on a simple alkyl halide product such as ethyl chloride (“CCCl”). This should return templates that match the desired transformation. Once we have a template ID, we can retrieve its SMARTS and map a reaction SMILES to produce the required `mapped_rxn` output.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCCl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
